title: Placement Hold and Pause Limits — Contingency Placement Agreements
content:
Two tier figures of the Contingency Placement Agreements bound how long new placements continue while fees are unpaid, and how long a pause the client asks for may last.

- **Past-due days before a hold** — the calendar days a fee invoice may stay unpaid past its due date before new placements are held.
- **Maximum pause** — the calendar days a client-requested placement pause may last before the client must resume or give termination notice.

| Tier | Past-due days before new placements are held | Maximum client-requested pause (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|
| Starter Contingency Agreement | 45 | 90 |
| Standard Contingency Agreement | 45 | 90 |
| Preferred Contingency Agreement | 60 | 120 |
| Select Volume Contingency Agreement | 60 | 120 |
| Enterprise Contingency Agreement | 75 | 180 |
| Strategic Partner Contingency Agreement | 90 | 180 |

**Comparing tiers (hypothetical).** A Standard Contingency Agreement and an Enterprise Contingency Agreement each have an invoice that has been unpaid for 50 days past its due date. The Standard figure of 45 days has been passed; the Enterprise figure of 75 days has not. A client on the Starter Contingency Agreement may pause new placements for no longer than 90 calendar days, and a client on the Strategic Partner Contingency Agreement for no longer than 180.
